NONE: › to leave or go away, used especially as a rude way of telling someone to go away

NONE: › to treat someone badly by wasting their time or causing problems for them

NONE: › to damage something or cause problems by doing something stupid

NONE: › used to show that you are extremely annoyed or bored with an activity and that you will not continue doing it
